definition.description: Retrieves the partner's indirect reseller relationships from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns a list of resellers with their MPN IDs, locations, and relationship states.

inputFields.helpText: Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Total number of resellers returned by the API
Number of resellers in the items array
Number of resellers with Active state
Number of resellers with non-Active state
JSON array of all reseller objects
JSON array of locations with counts (e.g., [{location: 'IT', count: 5}])
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when resellers were successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
